paras: J.P. Morgan Asset Management published its yearly long-term forecast for every major asset. For the <g>first time</g>, Bitcoin is on the list.
Its estimate: about <g>10% a year</g> over the next 10 years. That's above its forecast for US large-cap stocks and for gold.
<u>It's a forecast, not a promise</u>, from one of the biggest money managers on Wall Street.
slides.source: J.P. Morgan Asset Management 2027 Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions, via The Block, CoinDesk, Decrypt

paras: JPMorgan expects Bitcoin's price to swing about <r>55% a year</r>. That's why it still leaves Bitcoin out of its main portfolio models.
Its analysts say volatility and unstable links to other assets remain <r>an obstacle</r> to Bitcoin being widely held in portfolios.
They may change their approach if swings calm down and regulation gets clearer.
